strategy.primary: Nonartifact death → Missy returns it face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact → turn it face up → the printed nonartifact creature can die again. Free sacrifice outlets plus zero-cost-reveal morphs make this a commander-native infinite.
strategy.secondary: Steal opponents' dead nonartifact creatures through edicts and nonartifact sweepers, build a Cyberman army for the villainous-choice end step, and drain with aristocrats.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Missy
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Whenever another nonartifact creature dies, return it to the battlefield under your control face down and tapped. It's a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
At the beginning of your end step, each opponent faces a villainous choice — Each artifact creature you control deals 1 damage to that opponent, or you draw a card and chaos ensues.

identity.why: Second free morph (reveal a blue card).
Third free morph (reveal a red card); its face-up trigger also stops blockers.
Outlet that is also the kill.
